Name: SDV Argenti Mod (HSR)
Author: SukuroIsUseless
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=5][b]Adds Argenti to Stardew Valley!
[/b][/size][i]If you have any feedback or suggestions for this mod, don't be afraid to post them!
[/i][size=3]Thank you so much for 1k+ downloads- I hope you all like him 🥰[/size][/center]



This update ended up having a lot more in it than I thought it would

Regarding why all his festival outfits aren't done even after all this time, there's a few reasons.
[list=1]
[*]I'm lazy
[*]Making new sprite sheets and portrait sheets is so tedious, and I'm already not good at pixel art to begin with TvT
[*]I haven't been focusing on Argenti recently- I've been mainly working on Rerir and jumping between him and Faust
[*]I do have ideas for all his outfits drawn, except for his Spirit's Eve outfit. I thought it would be cool to have it be an AU I like, and was thinking about using the Horror AU cause y'know Halloween is the the spooky holiday, but I'd have to ask for permission and my brain thinks that is too scary but I'll think of something else eventually 😭
[/list]
[size=3][u]If you notice any bugs, spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, or conflicting dialogue, please let me know!
[/u][/size][i][size=1]I also didn't test whether or not I correctly made it possible for him to go to the resort, since the save I was testing on didn't have it unlocked, so please let me know if that works
[/size][/i]
[center]~~﻿[/center]
This mod was designed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] in mind- since I use SVE in all but one of my saves. Therefor, his placements reflect the changes that SVE makes. I only did minimal testing without SVE, so [b]if you don't use any mods that alter the vanilla locations and you see him standing inside any objects, tell me!

[/b]Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] mod installed will add more inventory to Argenti's shop, give him 5 more loved gifts, and make more flowers available in his garden, but it is not required.

Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] mod is recommended, since the style of his sprites are based around those.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugune[/url], which is worth mentioning since Eugene's house is in the same area as Argenti's house when you have SVE. You need to manually relocate Argenti's house in the config menu instead of it just happening automatically now.

Argenti Roses and other flowers will be unable to spawn in Argenti's garden without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url], but the mod should work fine without it.

[center]﻿~~[/center]
[left][size=5]﻿[/size]This Mod Adds:[/left][list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti as a fully fledged NPC![/i][/b][/size]
[/list] [size=2]His dialogue, sprites, and portraits were all made by me. (which is why the art isn't good lol I don't do pixel art)
﻿He even has seasonal outfits! + His Flower Dance outfit
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Events![/i][/b][/size]
[/list] [size=2]Currently, Argenti has all of his Heart Events, [/size]including a 14 Heart Event[size=2]. There is also an introduction event and one extra event.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti's Shop![/i][/b][/size]
[/list] [size=2]﻿Argenti runs a little stall in town that sells flowers! It's open Wednesday - Friday from 10 AM - 6 PM. This changes slightly when married.
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti's House![/i][/b][/size]
[/list] ﻿[size=2]Argenti's cottage is located in the forest, near the bottom of the lake. It requires 2 hearts with him to enter.
﻿You can change his house location, too. The alternate location is down near where Hat Mouse is.

[/size][list]
[*][b][i][size=3]White-Haired Argenti Option![/size][/i][/b]
[/list][size=2] ﻿Adds more white to Argenti's hair in his sprites and portraits, for the people who headcanon that he originally had white hair. [i]Default: Off
[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b][i][size=3]Safe Mode![/size][/i][/b]
[/list][size=2] ﻿A few lines of Argenti's dialogue after marriage imply or reference intimacy between him and the farmer. Turning on Safe Mode replaces those lines. [i]Default: Off


[/i][/size][u]To Be Added:[/u][list]
[*][i]Festival Outfits! [/i][size=1](The rest of them)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b][i]More Extra Heart Events![/i][/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b][i]Maybe more idk[/i][/b][/size]
[/list]
[left][/left][center]﻿~~[/center]
Included in the mod folder is a .txt filed named "Spoilers". Inside that file is Argenti's gift preferences, event requirements, etc.

[center]﻿~~[/center]
Mods present in the screenshots are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831]Dynamic Reflections[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]
